title: Prelaunch launch-readiness scan
description: Give one or more public website URLs. Each finished scan is charged once; URLs that are invalid, private or don't answer are reported and not charged.

urls.title: Website URLs
urls.description: Public sites to scan, for example https://your-app.vercel.app. Up to 100 per run. Duplicates are scanned once.

scanType.title: Scan type
scanType.description: Quick: exposed .env files, public source maps and security headers, in seconds. Full: every check in an anonymous Prelaunch scan, including headless-browser load, mobile, accessibility, performance, link and journey checks, SEO basics and a launch-traffic forecast.
enumTitles: Full (all passive checks with a real browser, usually under a minute)

includeScreenshots.title: Save screenshots (full scan)
includeScreenshots.description: Full scans only: store desktop, tablet and mobile screenshots in the run's key-value store and link them from each result.

maxConcurrency.title: Max parallel scans
maxConcurrency.description: How many sites to scan at once. Quick: up to 10 (default 5). Full: up to 2 (default 1), because each full scan drives a browser.
